author_notes: Dark Beast 9 ZIT 'Fast & Reliable Edition' — fused DBZ style into Moody Porn Mix 8 base for faster inference / sharper coherence / fewer hallucinations. Author recs (civitai 2242173): CFG 1, Steps 8, Euler+Simple, 1M-2M px. ZIT-distilled → zero-CFG guidance at minimal steps. Re-derived to 8-bit MLX (2026-06-22) from the bf16 source via run.py import-checkpoint; previously a 4-bit model converted from an fp8 checkpoint (double-quantization), so the 8-bit bf16-derived build halves the quantization error. NOT yet A/B tested in our stack — recommended_* are AUTHOR recs, pending empirical verification.
